text.tspan: What happens to one ticket, in order
evaluation/harness.py::process_ticket. The same sequence runs behind POST /ticket.
set_run_id(): one run_id for this whole invocation
grounding: each claim vs the passages
+ regex PII, instruction integrity, confidence floor (no model call)
row appended to results.jsonl · tickets_processed_total and response_seconds updated
loop: each ticket in --input (a crash escalates it as degraded, FR-23)
then metrics_report.json is written with no manual step (A10)
